Higgsfield Black Friday 2026: what you save per second

Edited by Emmanuel Gonzalez

Some links on this page are affiliate links. Affiliate disclosure.

Higgsfield has posted a Black Friday 2026 sale on its own pricing page. As of Nov 19, 2026, 7:20 PM ET (4:20 PM PT), Plus annual is $33/mo billed yearly and Ultra 3K annual is $50/mo billed yearly. The official sale record ends at 2026-11-23T00:00:00Z, which is November 22, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT). The tax-inclusive checkout totals are unknown.

Last checked 2026-11-19. Official card prices were read Nov 19, 2026, 7:20 PM ET (4:20 PM PT). Catalog per-second rows use the date on each row.

Checked Nov 19, 2026, 7:20 PM ET (4:20 PM PT) on the Higgsfield pricing page. The page banner says “BLACK FRIDAY 63% OFF” and “Don’t miss your chance to get up to 63% OFF.” Prices exclude VAT and local taxes, calculated at checkout. Always confirm the price on Higgsfield's page before you buy. Affiliate links never change this price order.

What is on the cards today

These figures were read on the Individual plan cards at Nov 19, 2026, 7:20 PM ET (4:20 PM PT). A percent off is the label on that card, measured against Higgsfield's own list price, and is not 63% on every plan.

  • Starter: $19/mo, monthly or billed yearly, 270 credits. No Black Friday cut was shown on the card.
  • Plus annual: $33/mo billed yearly (list $59, labeled −45%, Save $312), 1,200 credits / month.
  • Ultra 3K annual: $50/mo billed yearly (list $129, labeled −60%, Save $948), 3,000 credits / month.
  • Ultra 6K annual: $97/mo billed yearly (list $258, labeled −62%, Save $1,836), 6,000 credits / month. Save $1,836 uses the $250 monthly list, not $258.
  • Ultra 9K annual: $139/mo billed yearly (list $387, labeled −63%, Save $2,832), 9,000 credits / month. Save $2,832 uses the $375 monthly list, not $387.
  • Plus monthly: $47 first month, “billed monthly, renews at $59,” labeled 20% off, 1,200 credits / month.
  • Ultra 3K monthly: $79 first month, “billed monthly, renews at $129,” labeled 40% off, 3,000 credits / month.
  • Ultra 6K monthly: $150 first month, “billed monthly, renews at $250,” 6,000 credits / month.
  • Ultra 9K monthly: $209 first month, “billed monthly, renews at $375,” labeled 45% off, 9,000 credits / month.

Plus and Ultra annual and monthly cards also say “Unlimited models for 7 days,” only on higgsfield.ai. When that 7-day window starts or ends is unknown. The promotion also mentions a roughly $100 gift card for games for the first 10,000 eligible new annual Ultra subscribers, from Nov 20. The Business tab still showed Team annual at $45/seat/mo billed yearly (−43%, Save $120) and Scale annual at $80/seat/mo billed yearly (−63%, Save $480), and Team monthly $55 / Scale monthly $120; those checkout prices match the earlier standing discounts. The Business tab says “up to 63% OFF.” Scale annual still shows 30 days of unlimited Seedance 2.5 at 25s, 720p, after business verification; Team annual shows 14 days of unlimited Seedance 2.0 at 15s, 720p, not Seedance 2.5.

Unknown: the tax-inclusive amount charged at checkout; whether annual sale prices remain after the sale for new buyers or at renewal (the help article How do promo prices work? says a promo price applies to the first payment or the period stated in the offer, then the plan renews at the standard price; the annual cards do not spell out a post-sale price; the plans API records renew_monthly_price at the sale rate with duration “forever”). A plans API response without the plan-set key the page uses (ps_a3) returned lower Plus and Starter prices ($27/$39 and $15); those figures are not what the visible Individual cards show. The official end is stated above; vendors sometimes extend sales.

The 11.11 sale, now ended

The 11.11 sale is over. First-month Plus and Ultra offers in the deal record were marked ended Nov 15, 2026, then appeared again on the Monthly cards during this extended Black Friday window. The official 11.11 deals post and the earlier sale countdown pointed at that window (the public sale record ended at 2026-11-15T00:00:00Z, which is November 14, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT); that older ends_at is no longer the live sale_11_11 record on the pricing page, which now holds the Black Friday window). Recorded 11.11 / standing prices, last verified Nov 12 in the deal record, were Plus annual $35/mo and Ultra 3K annual $65/mo, and first-month Plus $47 / Ultra 3K $79. Those annual figures are not the cards shown today. The monthly first-month amounts on today’s cards happen to match the old first-month figures, but this page does not treat them as a continuation of 11.11.

What you actually save per second

The formula is the same one the rest of VidFare uses for credit plans: plan dollars per month, divided by credits per month, times credits per clip, divided by seconds in the clip, assuming every paid credit is used. Unused credits make the real cost per second higher. Wan 3.0 and Wan 3.0 Prime credit rates on the pricing-page compare table have no tilde. Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, and Hailuo 2.3 are marked approximate on that table, so those rows are estimates. VidFare's Kling 3.0 catalog rows use 7.5 credits per 5 seconds at 720p and 8.75 at 1080p, from Higgsfield's yearly clip counts, not the "~7" / "~8" shorthand.

Each row names the model, resolution, and audio. Audio is not stated on these Higgsfield plan rows. The four rate columns are catalog plan tiers: Plus monthly at the $59/mo list price for 1,200 credits; Plus annual at the $33/mo billed-yearly sale price for 1,200 credits; Ultra 3K monthly at the $129/mo list price for 3,000 credits; Ultra 3K annual at the $50/mo billed-yearly sale price for 3,000 credits. The monthly columns do not use the first-month card prices. Figures are from the price catalog, last checked 2026-11-19. Higgsfield pricing page.

On Ultra 6K annual at $97/mo for 6,000 credits, the same 5-second 480p Wan 3.0 Prime clip is $0.0243/s. That figure is computed from the card price verified Nov 19, 2026, 7:20 PM ET (4:20 PM PT) and the catalog credit rate; it is not a row in the price catalog. On Ultra 9K annual at $139/mo for 9,000 credits, that same clip is $0.0232/s. That figure is computed from the card price verified Nov 19, 2026, 7:20 PM ET (4:20 PM PT) and the catalog credit rate; it is not a row in the price catalog.

A first-month monthly price looks cheaper in that first month and much closer to the regular monthly rate over 12 months. For Plus, $47 the first month and $59 for the next 11 months is $58 a month on average. That blend is illustrative; Higgsfield does not print it.

    What to recheck

    Whether the official 2026-11-23T00:00:00Z end still holds after November 22, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT), in case the sale is extended. The tax-inclusive checkout total. Whether annual sale prices stay at $33, $50, $97, and $139 after the sale. Whether the “Unlimited models for 7 days” window is still offered. Whether a plans API call without the plan-set key still returns different Plus and Starter prices than the visible cards.

    Has Higgsfield announced a Black Friday 2026 sale?

    Yes. On Nov 19, 2026, 7:20 PM ET (4:20 PM PT) the official pricing page showed a “BLACK FRIDAY 63% OFF” banner and “up to 63% OFF” on the Individual Annual cards. Plus annual was $33/mo billed yearly, and Ultra 3K annual was $50/mo billed yearly. The official sale record ends at 2026-11-23T00:00:00Z, which is November 22, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT). The 11.11 sale is over. The same Monthly cards still show first-month Plus and Ultra prices during this extended Black Friday window.

    When does the Black Friday sale end?

    The official sale record on the pricing page (still named sale_11_11, with phase pre_black_friday_63) ends at 2026-11-23T00:00:00Z, which is November 22, 2026, 7:00 PM ET (4:00 PM PT). The visible banner is only a countdown (“Offer ends in”); it does not print that calendar date. Vendors sometimes extend sales, so the banner should be rechecked after that time. Checkout totals remain unknown.

    What will I pay at checkout?

    Unknown. The pricing page says prices exclude VAT and local taxes, which are calculated at checkout. The card prices below are the pre-tax figures shown on the page, not a completed checkout total.

    How is dollars per second calculated?

    A credit-plan rate is plan price divided by monthly credits, times credits per clip, divided by seconds in that clip. That math assumes every paid credit is used. A figure the vendor marks with a tilde, or that VidFare already stores as an estimate, is labeled an estimate. Seedance 2.5 has no Higgsfield plan credit rate in the catalog, so it has no plan dollars-per-second here. The monthly columns use the catalog list prices (Plus $59/mo, Ultra 3K $129/mo), not the first-month card prices.
